IRS990.MissionDesc: ACLU Foundation of San Diego & Imperial Counties, Inc. (the Foundation) is a California Nonprofit Corporation (exempt under Section 501(c)(3)) incorporated on December 23, 1988. The Foundation works to protect and expand fairness, equity, and freedom through community engagement, building power, policy advocacy, and impact litigation.
IRS990.Desc: The Foundation works to protect and expand fairness, equity, and freedom through community engagement, building power, policy advocacy, and impact litigation.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Part V, Line 4: Intended uses of the endowment fund.
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE PURPOSE OF THE TRUST IS TO BUILD AN ENDURING ENDOWMENT TO CARRY OUT THE WORK OF THE FOUNDATIONS IN PROTECTING, PRESERVING AND EXPANDING THE CIVIL LIBERTIES OF ALL PERSONS THROUGHOUT THE UNITED STATES.
The Organization believes that it has appropriate support for any tax positions taken, and as such, does not have any uncertain tax positions that are material to the financial statements.

Form 990, Part VI, Section A, Line 2
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Pat Wilson and Greg Rose both serve on our board and have a family relationship.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 11b
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE DRAFT FORM 990 IS REVIEWED BY THE BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE, THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR, AND THE TREASURER WHO PROVIDES THE INFORMATION TO THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 12c
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: IN CASE OF A CONFLICT OF INTEREST ISSUE, THE BOARD WOULD REVIEW THE SITUATION. THERE HAVE BEEN NO KNOWN CONFLICTS OF INTEREST FOR THE YEAR THEN ENDED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 15b
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR'S PERFORMANCE IS EVALUATED ANNUALLY BY THE BOARD. THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE REVIEWS THE EVALUATIONS AND COMPARABLE SALARY DATA AND RECOMMENDS COMPENSATION TO THE BOARD. UPON BOARD APPROVAL, A MEMO DOCUMENTING THE COMPENSATION CHANGE IS PROVIDED TO THE BUSINESS MANAGER FOR PAYROLL/PERSONNEL PURPOSES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section C, Line 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION WILL PROVIDE THE GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, POLICIES AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS TO ANY PERSON WHO REQUESTS THIS INFORMATION IN WRITING.
